provenance.exact_claim_text: Intervention A has been shown to outperform Intervention B.

evidence.text: Cited company source 1 studies Intervention A alone; it contains no A-vs-B comparison.
Cited company source 2 studies Intervention B alone; it contains no A-vs-B comparison.
The documented literature search returned no direct A-vs-B head-to-head study.

query_terms: Intervention A vs Intervention B head-to-head

negative_assertions.proposition: No direct head-to-head study comparing Intervention A and Intervention B was identified.

findings.proposition: No head-to-head A-vs-B comparison was identified within the documented search scope.
findings.verdict_summary: The cited sources study each intervention alone; a documented structured search identified no direct head-to-head comparison.

client_findings.display_claim: In the reviewed sources and a documented search, no direct head-to-head comparison of A and B was identified.
client_findings.client_explanation: The cited sources study each intervention separately, and a documented structured search found no direct head-to-head study. This does not establish that no such study exists anywhere.
